verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a public REST API backed by an OpenAPI 3.0 spec and a versioning policy. Raw data can be pushed via API endpoint for normalization and testing. Its official MCP server docs explicitly address no-browser setups such as CI jobs and scripts, so headless automation is clearly supported. missing for 10: a first-party CLI or CI integration (e.g., a pipeline action or plugin), complete documentation of headless auth/CI setup (the CI snippet is truncated), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
